Goal
* Please format every occurrence of the variable name "n" as a [[variable]].

* Please change "each term every n+1 values" to "every ([[n]]{{+1}})th term".

* Please change "than" to "as".

* Please move the note inside brackets in the Output section to this section.

  • After that, format "1" as a {{constant}}.

  • Also, consider changing "rank" to "index". While both are valid, "index" is more commonly used in a programming context.

Input
* Line 1: Please replace "n" with "Two space-separated integers, [[n]]".

* Line 2: Please replace "The" with "[[n]] space-separated integers, representing the".

Constraints
* Please format n and k as [[variables]].

* Please add a constraint on the lower and upper bounds for the terms of the given sequence.

Cases
* Validator 8: It should be renumbered (#10) or renamed (Random sequence, extreme case).

* In most cases, the answer is one of the first few terms of the given sequence. Would it be possible to modify or add some test cases so that the expected answers are more varied?

Thanks.
I think that I did all the needed changes, except the last one (I’ll think about it).
The last one should be done.

I notice that some of the requested changes haven't yet been made. I'll try to explain them more clearly below.

Goal
* Please change "each term every n+1 values" to "every ([[n]]{{+1}})th term". The current wording is a bit unclear in expressing the intended operation, whereas the revised wording is simpler and more direct.

* Please move "(beware, the first term’s rank of the sequence is 1)" to the Goal section. The definition of [[k]] in this section relies on this clarification, so it'd be clearer to state it here rather than in the Output section.

* Please consider changing "rank of" to "index in". While both are valid, "index" is more commonly used in a programming context.

Constraints
* Please add a constraint on the lower and upper bounds for the terms of the [[n]] given terms, e.g.

0 ≤ each of the [[n]] first terms of the sequence ≤ 100

Cases
* Thank you for updating the cases. I'd suggest updating two more:

  • Random sequence, hard case (test): Change 1515 to 1512.

  • Random sequence, hard case (validator): Change 1789 to 1778.

Thanks again 🙂

I think that I forgot no change now.
Thanks for all of them!
